semantics.pre_decode_rule: Every complete inbound frame is subject to the authoritative generic C01 complete-original-frame bound before body allocation.
semantics.post_decode_rule: Capability-family validation remains required for frames admitted by C01, but it is not an independent C02 size admission boundary.

streaming_classifier_rejection.reason: A bounded streaming family classifier would duplicate transport parsing and correlation solely to distinguish a frame before decode, while C01 already supplies the required generic pre-allocation size refusal. The added parser, state, and lifecycle surface is disproportionate and would create a second interpretation path for JSON-RPC identity.
streaming_classifier_rejection.preserved_behavior: No production behavior changes. Existing C01 admission and post-decode capability validation remain authoritative.
